q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of recycled PET flakes per kilogram?
title: PET bottle flakes carbon per kg
short: Add the wash line electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25 and the hot wash heating fuel at its default factor, then divide by kilograms of clean flakes. Add collection and baling transport from the aggregator, and report process losses.
audience: PET recyclers and brands buying recycled PET

ul: Hot washing with caustic and detergent.

p: Labels, caps, dirt and fines are lost. Divide by clean flakes out, not bales in, and report the yield.
Buyers may compare with virgin resin. Keep your flake figure as measured and present any comparison as a separate, labelled estimate using the resin supplier's factor.

example.title: Worked example: one month (illustrative inputs)
lines: Electricity (shredder, washers, dryers): 95,000 kWh x 0.710 = 67,450 kg CO2
Hot wash heating PNG: 12,000 scm x 2.05 = 24,600 kg CO2
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use electricity and gas bills and the production register.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 records. A per-unit figure divides those by the output you enter, and purchased materials are added from supplier data on the Scope 3 trail, labelled by source.
